Image Color Picker

Click to upload or drag & drop an image, then use the eyedropper to select a color. You can also use the arrow keys for pixel-perfect selection.

▸How to Use

Follow these simple steps to grab any color from your image. All processing is done securely in your browser.

  • ❶
    Select Your Image

    Click the "Upload Image" button to choose a file from your device. Your image will appear in the main canvas area.

  • ❷
    Activate the Eyedropper

    Press the "Activate Eyedropper" button. This enables color selection mode and brings up the live magnifier.

  • ❸
    Pick Your Color

    Move your mouse over the image to see the magnifier and color preview update in real-time. Use the zoom controls or arrow keys for fine-tuning. Click to select the final color and instantly see its HEX, RGB, and HSL codes.

✦Key Features

Our Image Color Picker is designed for accuracy, privacy, and ease of use. Here's what makes it stand out:

  • ◆
    Completely Private

    All color processing happens in your browser. Images are never uploaded to a server, ensuring 100% privacy and security.

  • ◈
    Zoom & Pan Controls

    Easily navigate high-resolution images. Zoom in for incredible detail and pan across the canvas to find the perfect area.

  • →
    Magnifying Glass

    A live, magnified preview of the area under your cursor allows you to select the exact pixel you need with confidence.

  • ⎯
    Keyboard Navigation

    After activating the eyedropper, use your keyboard's arrow keys to nudge the selection one pixel at a time for ultimate precision.

  • ■
    Multiple Color Formats

    Instantly get your selected color in HEX, RGB, and HSL formats. Each value is ready to be copied with a single click.

  • ⚡
    Interactive Canvas

    The tool uses a powerful HTML5 canvas, providing a smooth and responsive experience even with large image files.

✦Why Our Color Picker is an Essential Tool

Getting the exact color from an image is crucial for designers, developers, and artists. A mismatched color can disrupt a brand's identity, throw off a design's harmony, or make a digital illustration look unprofessional. This tool bridges the gap between inspiration and implementation.

Whether you are a web developer matching a client's logo color, a graphic designer creating a cohesive brand palette, or a digital artist sampling colors from a reference photo, our color picker provides the pixel-perfect accuracy you need. It eliminates guesswork, saves you time, and ensures your projects maintain a professional, consistent look and feel across any medium.

You can upload most standard web image formats, including .JPG, .JPEG, .PNG, .GIF, .WEBP, and .BMP. For the best results, use uncompressed or high-quality images.

While there's no hard limit enforced, performance may vary with extremely large image files (over 15MB). The tool is optimized for typical web and design images for a fast and smooth experience.
